We plan to continue to expand our business, drive restaurant sales growth, and enhance our competitive positioning by executing the following five key strategies:
To increase comparable restaurant sales, we plan to increase customer frequency, attract new customers, and improve per-person spend.

For the remainder of fiscal 2026, we plan to continue our standard practices for remodels, which includes a goal of completing a total of 28 to 32 company-operated restaurant remodels and 28 to 37 franchise-operated restaurant remodels.
Like other expense items, we expect labor costs to grow proportionately as our restaurant revenue grows.
When we close a restaurant, we will evaluate the ROU asset for impairment, based on anticipated sublease recoveries.
In addition, in evaluating EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA, you should be aware that in the future we will incur expenses or charges such as those added back to calculate EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA.
Our presentation of EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA should not be construed as an inference that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or nonrecurring items.

Our material cash requirements relate mostly to future (i) debt payments, including expected interest expense, calculated based on current interest rates, (ii) restaurant operating lease payments, (iii) purchasing commitments for chicken, (iv) restaurant finance lease payments, and (v) capital expenditures.

estimates.t: The preparation of our condensed consolidated financial statements in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”) requires us to make estimates and judgments that affect our reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenue, and expenses, and related disclosures of continge

estimates.name: Key Financial Definitions — Revenue
estimates.t: Our revenue is derived from three primary sources: company-operated restaurant revenue, franchise revenue, which is comprised primarily of franchise royalties and, to a lesser extent, franchise fees and sublease rental income, and franchise advertising fee revenue.

estimates.name: Food and Paper Costs
estimates.t: Food and paper costs include the direct costs associated with food, beverage and packaging of our menu items.

estimates.name: Labor and Related Expenses
estimates.t: Labor and related expenses include wages, payroll taxes, workers’ compensation expense, benefits, and bonuses paid to our restaurant management teams.

estimates.name: Occupancy Costs and Other Operating Expenses
estimates.t: Occupancy costs include rent, common area maintenance (“CAM”), and real estate taxes.

estimates.name: General and Administrative Expenses
estimates.t: General and administrative expenses are comprised of expenses associated with corporate and administrative functions that support the development and operations of our restaurants, including compensation and benefits, travel expenses, stock-based compensation expense, legal and professional fees, an…

estimates.name: Franchise Expenses
estimates.t: Franchise expenses are primarily comprised of rent expenses incurred on properties leased or owned by us and then sublet to franchisees, expenses incurred in support of franchisee information technology systems, and the franchisee’s portion of advertising expenses.

estimates.name: Depreciation and Amortization
estimates.t: Depreciation and amortization primarily consists of the depreciation of property and equipment, including leasehold improvements and equipment.

estimates.name: Loss on Disposal of Assets
estimates.t: Loss on disposal of assets includes the loss on disposal of assets related to retirements and replacement or write-off of leasehold improvements or equipment.

estimates.name: Impairment and Closed-Store Reserves
estimates.t: In determining future cash flows, significant estimates are made by us with respect to future operating results of each restaurant over its remaining lease term, including sales trends, labor rates, commodity costs and other operating cost assumptions.

estimates.name: Interest Expense, Net
estimates.t: Interest expense, net, consists primarily of interest on our outstanding debt.

estimates.name: Provision for Income Taxes
estimates.t: Provision for income taxes consists of federal and state taxes on our pre-tax income.

estimates.name: Comparison of Results of Operations
estimates.t: Our operating results for the thirteen and thirty-nine weeks ended September 30, 2026 and September 24, 2025 are expressed as percentages of total revenue, with the exception of cost of operations and company restaurant expenses, which are expressed as percentages of company-operated restaurant reve…

estimates.name: ​ — ​ — ​ — Company-Operated Restaurant Revenue
estimates.t: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, company-operated restaurant revenue increased $4.7 million, or 4.6% from the comparable period in the prior year.

estimates.name: Franchise Revenue
estimates.t: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, franchise revenue decreased $0.4 million, or 3.0% from the comparable period in the prior year.

estimates.name: Franchise Advertising Fee Revenue
estimates.t: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, franchise advertising fee revenue increased $0.5 million, or 6.5% from the comparable period in the prior year.
